notes: red_01 carries a fire brazier, which breaks the rule that red uses the crown and never a flame, and its only crown shield is side-on behind the rear wheel, so at gameplay distance the variant reads as red plus flame. The yellow_01 sun on a gold shield and the green_01 leaf on a teal shield cannot be read at 40 studs, and yellow_01 is at 3982/4000 tris.
